A: A subject access request must ordinarily be answered within 40 days of receipt.
B: A subject access request must ordinarily be answered within one month of receipt.

Answer with a single letter, A or B.

AUTHORITATIVE MATERIAL

UK GDPR, Article 12(3): the controller shall provide information on action taken on a request under Articles 15 to 22 'without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request', extendable by two further months where necessary taking into account the complexity and number of requests.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

A junior colleague has confirmed:
A subject access request must ordinarily be answered within 40 days of receipt.
